name: Eagers Automotive
h1: Next100 growth across two countries, one view
lede: Eagers is scaling through CanadaOne, its Mitsubishi Corporation alliance and easyauto123. Airtable gives the teams integrating that growth one connected view of the work.
why_p: Record results, a first offshore market and new partners mean more programs to coordinate across a larger dealer network.

signals.title: Record half-year revenue
signals.body: Eagers reported record 1H26 revenue of $8.05bn, up 24%, including the first two months of CanadaOne Auto results.
signals.angle: Bring Australian, New Zealand and Canadian reporting and initiatives into one shared operating view.

signals.title: Mitsubishi Corporation alliance at the AGM
signals.body: The AGM outlined the strategic alliance with Mitsubishi Corporation, which invested in both Eagers and a 20% stake in easyauto123.
signals.angle: Coordinate joint workstreams with a strategic partner in one place with clear owners and timelines.

signals.title: CanadaOne Auto partnership completed
signals.body: Eagers completed its 65% investment in CanadaOne Auto on 30 April 2026, its first expansion outside Australia and New Zealand.
signals.angle: Track cross-border integration, franchise compliance and milestones without spreadsheets passed between teams.
